source_reference: UI-02 Add Capture, Snap to Objects and Snap to Similar Objects labels; composition index exports
fixture: Synthetic composition with two placed image layers and known edge/near-object coordinates.
trigger: Use snapPlacementToEdges and record Add Capture plus object-snap variants.
target_observation_needed: Record capture placement and the meaning/threshold of object and similar-object snapping.
ferby_observation_needed: Record SnapResult, threshold behavior and layer ordering from the public exports.
acceptance_rule: Compare placement and snapping only after separately recording target behavior.
limitations: The public API exposes edge snapping but not object similarity or Add Capture workflow wiring.

source_reference: UI-05 Backdrop/Shadow/Inset/Recenter labels; T03 editor notes
fixture: Synthetic image composition with inner/outer radii, shadow and aspect-ratio presets.
trigger: Validate CompositionOptions and renderCompositionToPngBlob across backdrop, inset, shadow and recenter variants.
target_observation_needed: Record output layout, radii, aspect behavior and actual Recenter/Remove actions.
ferby_observation_needed: Record validation, output dimensions and layer order from composition exports.
acceptance_rule: Compare rendered layout and actions only to measured target observations.
limitations: Selector names and exported composition functions do not prove `clickAutocrop:`/`clickReset:` wiring.

source_reference: UI-05 Solid, Colormix, Image and gradient labels
fixture: Synthetic layered composition with solid, mesh/vertical/diagonal/radial gradient and image-blur choices.
trigger: Render each background template and a missing/invalid image-source boundary.
target_observation_needed: Record available templates, image source behavior and rendered pixels.
ferby_observation_needed: Record CompositionOptions validation and rendered output/error for each choice.
acceptance_rule: Compare templates, pixels and errors only after target results are recorded.
limitations: The API does not establish that every named template or image source is wired to the UI.

source_reference: UI-15 Wallpaper, Transparent, Solid Color and Trim shadow labels
fixture: Synthetic window/composition with transparent, solid-color, wallpaper and trimmed-shadow variants.
trigger: Render each background mode and attempt trim-shadow at dimension boundaries.
target_observation_needed: Record resulting window/shadow pixels and platform restrictions.
ferby_observation_needed: Record composition validation, output pixels and unsupported-boundary errors.
acceptance_rule: Compare pixels and restrictions only against separately recorded target observations.
limitations: The public composition API cannot prove native window behavior or platform support.
